physicalNotes: Radius 0.358 +/- 0.015 solar radii from Almenara et al. 2024, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-4860 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...683A.166A/abstract): 249,061 km at 695,700 km per solar radius.
